title: Canonical finite section comparison with its etale presentation
statement: Use the fixed finite purity coefficients [def-pur-conventions] A=A_{E,n}. For a compactifiable separated finite-type morphism g:V→B of finite-type k-schemes, let Rg! be the transported constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and use the actual derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. In the sheaf-of-A-modules realization, put C_pro(g,s)=Ls* Rg! A_B for any s:B→V, the finite realization of [def-pur-section-invariant]. Its ordinary-etale presentation is C_et(g,s)=Ls* g^× A_B. Define the canonical comparison σ:C_pro(g,s)≅ν_B* C_et(g,s) using the actual etale/pro-etale comparison morphisms [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]: first identify Rν_* A_pro with A_et by applying Rν_* to ν* A_et≅A_pro and inverting the comparison adjunction unit at A_et; apply g^× and ν_V*, then derive the canonical commutation s*ν_V*≅ν_B*s*. The positive finite coefficient quotient is finite, the coefficient unit is bounded below, and the etale exceptional right adjoint preserves bounded-below objects over a Noetherian target; these supply the required interfaces, rather than extra assumptions. Every construction is the actual published functor or its derived comparison, and no isomorphism is chosen from an unspecified nonempty set.
